hard_contract.description: Jetson Nano acts solely as a research work plane emitting immutable CandidateBundles. It possesses zero canonical write permissions. All graph admissions, schedulings, and quarantine decisions belong strictly to the regulatory control plane (UNO Q).

bounded_primary_research_uow.target_query: Find primary-source evidence bearing on whether Feldbaum's dual-control formulation explicitly distinguishes information-gathering action from directing action.

extracted_fragments.text: In systems with unobserved random parameters, the control action carries a dual character: it must simultaneously probe the object to reduce parameter uncertainty (investigative step) and drive the plant toward the target state (directing step).

control_plane_admission_decision.reason: ADMIT: Passed all cryptographic, causal, referential, authority, and epistemic gates.

gate_1_direct_canonical_write_refusal.description: Worker exposes zero database commit methods; output restricted to CandidateBundle.

gate_2_dangling_reference_quarantined.description: Relations referencing ungrounded ghost nodes are quarantined.

gate_3_hash_mismatch_tampering_rejected.description: Payload alterations after digest calculation trigger instant rejection.

gate_4_bundle_replay_idempotent_rejected.description: Resubmissions of admitted UoW or bundle hash are rejected idempotently.

gate_5_superseded_uow_arrival_rejected.description: Stale bundles arriving with causal sequence <= high-water mark are dropped.

gate_6_epistemic_overpromotion_downgrade.description: Claims asserting HISTORICALLY_SUPPORTED without evidence fragments are downgraded to HYPOTHETICAL.

gate_7_geometry_authority_attempt_refuse.description: Attempts by geometric thread to disable shadow mode or override schedule are refused.

gate_8_duplicate_candidate_deduplicated.description: Candidates already canonicalized are marked DEDUP and filtered from re-insertion.
